SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   D. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   D. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The School as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say The School never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.

8. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.

9. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   D. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   B. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   D. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
